comment: Performance budgets (R-PERF-1, R-PERF-2; tools/perf.py, check C-PERF). `milestone` names the budgets in force. Sizes are bytes: code (code and constants in the image), static_ram (initialised and zeroed data), stack_high_water (the deepest the stack went in the one-second perf run). speed_rise_percent: the most instructions per period may rise against the latest main record. Raising a budget, or moving to the next milestone's, takes its own pull request that says why (What/Why/How/Result), with nothing else in it.
